body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> SwitchEasy Limited is proud to announce the immediate availability of its latest creation, CANVAS folio protection solution for iPad.

CANVAS is the most comprehensive folio casing solution with added versatile stand function. Offering 2 different viewing angles CANVAS transforms into a stand with ease. Extremely convenient and easy to use, CANVAS is the perfect folio / stand solution for your everyday needs.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
